description.p: When you cast eldritch blast, you can cast Eldritch Beam instead. Once you do so, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

A line of eldritch energy 60 feet long and 5 feet wide emanates from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 4d6 force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Any other Eldritch Invocation that affects your eldritch blast also applies to Eldritch Beam.

sheet.description: You cast Eldritch Beam, forcing anyone in a 60 feet long and 5 feet wide line to make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 4d6 force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Invocations that affect Eldritch Blast also apply.

p.i: You can equip this item to “enable” it. It remains hidden from the inventory on your character sheet.

description.p: You are allowed to choose one more eldritch invocation.
